name: Log drum (penv bounce)
desc: The signature amapiano log drum: a percussive sine bass with a downward penv glide on every hit, bouncing between octaves (d1<->d2) through a syncopated Dm-Dm-Bb-C walk. Sparse leaves air between the boings; full is the interlocking bounce with a 16-cycle filter tide and phrase-end ply fills; peak busies the roll and hangs an octave-up ghost canon over it.

glide.doc: penv glide depth in semitones (the log-drum boing)

cut.doc: lpf center Hz (lets the attack click through)

code.full: note("<[d2 ~ ~ d1 ~ d2 ~ d1 d2 ~ ~ a1 ~ f1 ~ ~] [d2 ~ ~ d1 ~ d2 ~ d1 d2 ~ ~ a1 ~ c2 ~ ~] [bb1 ~ ~ bb2 ~ bb1 ~ bb2 bb1 ~ ~ f1 ~ d1 ~ ~] [c2 ~ ~ c1 ~ c2 ~ c1 c2 ~ ~ g1 ~ a1 ~ ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(${glide}).pdec(.09).attack(.001).decay(.24).sustain(0).release(.06).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(3).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).room(.12).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[d2 ~ d1 d2 ~ d2 d1 d2 d1 ~ d2 a1 ~ f1 d2 c2] [d2 ~ d1 d2 ~ d2 d1 d2 d1 ~ d2 a1 ~ c2 d2 e2] [bb1 ~ bb2 bb1 ~ bb1 bb2 bb1 bb2 ~ bb1 f1 ~ d1 bb1 c2] [c2 ~ c1 c2 ~ c2 c1 c2 c1 ~ c2 g1 ~ a1 c2 d2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").penv(${glide}).pdec(.08).attack(.001).decay(.22).sustain(0).release(.05).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.8, ${cut}*1.8).slow(16)).lpq(4).shape(${drive}).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.4)).orbit(3).play()
